decision.interpretation: Bold, standalone line marking the start of a new chapter; introduces the substantive content following it on this page.
Uppercase bold title directly below the chapter marker; names the chapter's topic and opens the region.
Bold, standalone line marking a subsection within the chapter; introduces the section's content.
Uppercase bold title directly below the section marker; names the section's topic and opens the region.
Bold, numbered article heading ("Điều 49"); introduces the statutory provisions that follow immediately.
